question.text: Sortino Ratio differs from Sharpe by using:

answer.text: Downside (semi) standard deviation instead of full SD

explanation.text: The Logic: Sortino Ratio = (Rp - Rf) / downside semi-standard deviation. It adjusts for downside risk only, treating upside volatility as desirable. The Trap: Beta is used in the Treynor ratio; tracking error is used in the Information Ratio. Note: Definition per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.376): Sortino divides excess portfolio return by semi-standard deviation.
